card.name: Words right before "each other"
card.fires_on: The word just before a reciprocal phrase like "each other" or "one another", when the phrase is clearly about to follow. Seen after verbs, prepositions and "one" in text about two items acting on or placed near each other.

modes.label: Drug pairs
modes.description: Prepositions or verbs before "each other" when two drugs are said to interact, be swapped or be spaced apart.
modes.example: Sumatriptan and dihydroergotamine mesylate nasal spray should not be taken within 24 hours<< of>> each other.

modes.label: General reciprocal action
modes.description: "one" or a verb right before "another" or "each other" in everyday text about two things acting on one another.
modes.example: They housed squid in separate tubes to keep them from attacking<< one>> another.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words meaning "each other" (each, elkaar, 彼此, друг) and away from unrelated names.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "each other" or "one another" when the text is about two things affecting or sitting next to each other.
